blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Cebuano June Mar Fajardo became the latest member of the PBA’s 10,000-point club, which he achieved during San Miguel Beer’s comeback win over NLEX on Wednesday here. Fajardo, from Pinamungajan town in Cebu, scored 26 points in the Beermen’s 135-133 victory over the Road Warriors at the Ynares Center. Fajardo, thus, is the 19th player to reach 10,000 points in the PBA. Asked about the feat, the soft-spoken Fajardo said this was not on his mind when he first made it to the league as the No. 1 overall pick in the 2012 Rookie Draft.
